high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the verified account "selenagomez." The post features a still from what appears to be a romantic scene. In the image, two individuals are embracing each other closely. The person on the left has shoulder-length dark hair and is wearing a white dress with a high neckline. The person on the right has curly hair and is dressed in a dark suit with a light-colored shirt underneath. The background shows a natural setting with trees and a blurred outdoor environment, suggesting a serene and intimate atmosphere.
